newsitem.title: CANADA: ATCO awarded Chile structures contract.
newsitem.headline: ATCO awarded Chile structures contract.

text.p: ATCO Ltd unit ATCO Structures Inc said on Wednesday its joint venture company, Tecno Fast ATCO SA, was awarded at C$40.8-million contract to build a residence facility for the Collahuasi copper mining project in northern Chile.
ATCO said the 790-room permanent residence was the third major contract awarded to its joint venture for workforce housing for the project.
The US$1.75 billion Collahuasi project is co-owned by Falconbridge Ltd, Minorco SA and a Japanese consortium.
Manufacture of the facility was slated to start early December at a new Tecno Fast ATCO plant in Santiago.
ATCO said the residence required the manufacture of 500 modules totalling about 275,000 square feet and panelized products totalling 75,000 square feet.
The contract included living accommodation, recreation, kitchen/dining, office, administration and medical clinic facilities, it said.

Fabrication of the modules for the residence facility was scheduled for completion in July 1997, with installation due to be complete by September, ATCO said. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
